description: List the accounts behind a post’s likes or reposts without credentials, in provider order. Accepts a post AT-URI or bsky.app post URL; a handle authority costs one extra resolution request. Returns actor summaries with account creation and label provenance when supplied, and a separate likedAt timestamp for likes. Account counts and website are available through bsky_get_profile. Post likeCount and repostCount are upper bounds on retrievable interactions: cursor exhaustion does not prove every counted interaction was returned. Follow returned cursors with the same post and kind; no pages are walked automatically. Repost cursors retain Bluesky’s behavior, which can ignore malformed cursors and repeat a page.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous response for the same post and kind. Pass unchanged; omit for the first page.

kind.description: Interaction to list: likes includes likedAt; reposts has no interaction timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum accounts per page, default 25. Values above 100 are clamped with a notice unless read-limit clamping is disabled.

uri.description: Post AT-URI or https://bsky.app/profile/<handle-or-did>/post/<rkey> URL. URL trailing slash, query, and fragment are accepted. Feed, profile, and list references are rejected.

name: bsky_get_post_interactions

items.description: An account that liked or reposted the post.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 account creation timestamp, when supplied.

displayName.description: Display name set by the account.

items.description: A moderation label with optional provenance.

cts.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the label was applied.

likedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this account liked the post; present for likes only, distinct from account creation.

pronouns.description: Free-form pronouns supplied by the account.

verification.description: Verification statuses when supplied; bsky_get_profile returns issuer details.

trustedVerifierStatus.description: Trusted-verifier status from Bluesky, such as valid, invalid, or none.

verifiedStatus.description: Account verification status from Bluesky, such as valid, invalid, or none.

cap.description: Applied page limit when a continuation cursor is present.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor. Absence ends traversal, without proving every counted interaction was returned.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `post_not_found`: The post does not exist or its handle cannot be resolved. `invalid_cursor`: Bluesky cannot decode the supplied like cursor and returns HTTP 500. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Pagination, empty-page, clamping, and counter-completeness guidance.

shown.description: Accounts shown on a page with a continuation cursor.

truncated.description: True exactly when Bluesky returned a cursor, regardless of page size.

uri.description: DID-form AT-URI of the queried post.

title: Get Bluesky Post Interactions
